title: FinProBench：基于专业交付物的角色接地评分标准评估金融AI代理
summary: FinProBench是一个金融专业任务基准，提出角色接地评分标准构建（RGRC）流水线，从从业者交付物中提取隐性标准。在角色专业化任务上显著优于纯提示方法（99.1% vs 78.0%），包含1723个交付物、57个职业，初始评估集20个任务。
summary_en: FinProBench is a benchmark for professional financial tasks with Role-Grounded Rubric Construction (RGRC), deriving rubrics from practitioner deliverables. It outperforms prompt-only methods on role-specialized tasks (99.1% vs 78.0%), covering 1,723 deliverables across 57 occupations.
